classification.summary: ControllerV4.swapExactJarForJar validated only approvedJarConverters for the call targets and never checked that _fromJar/_toJar were Pickle jars, so an attacker-deployed fake jar turned the controller into an arbitrary-call proxy that withdrew the real DAI strategy's cDAI.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/pickle-finance.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: I read the verified ControllerV4 source at 0x6847259b - swapExactJarForJar only requires approvedJarConverters[_targets[i]], with no jar whitelist; contract created 2020-10-23 by 0xf00d98806a785bb0e1854a0ccc8a39c9c4f4316a, not by attack sender 0xbac8a476; loss of 19,759,355 DAI counted 1:1 in USD. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): ControllerV4's runtime is unchanged - identical keccak(eth_getCode) at the creation block 11109198 and the incident block 11303123 - and it holds no implementation slot. The single DELEGATECALL taken in the exploit goes to the jar converter 0x6186e99d9cfb05e1fdf1b442178806e81da21dd8, which the same Pickle deployer 0xf00d98806a785bb0e1854a0ccc8a39c9c4f4316a created 278 s after the controller (block 11109222) and whitelisted in approvedJarConverters (mapping at slot 11) 288 s after it (block 11109224, 2020-10-23T00:09:04Z), verified by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on keccak(converter . 11) - the same deployment session, and worth 288 s out of a 2.57 M-second age, so deployment remains the basis.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/pickle-finance.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The exploit block or transaction index remains unresolved.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
